title: No laptops, no labs: How IIT Delhi alumnus is bringing coding to rural students
script:
Zero laptops and zero labs stopped IIT Delhi alumnus Prashant Chaudhary.
He just won the Rohini Nayyar prize for his rural education work.
He built the CodeYogi Foundation to bring technology education to students using basic smartphones.
His initiative uses an AI-powered learning platform that works on basic family smartphones.
Over 350000 students across nine states and 120 districts have been reached through this platform.
Could AI bring tech education to every village?
